status: Dated research proposal; not the current product contract
principle: A smart Studio spends the user's attention only where attention changes the outcome.

mechanics.name: Adaptive checkpoints
mechanics.idea: Confirm at meaningful branch points instead of every step or only at the end.

mechanics.name: Goldilocks transparency
mechanics.idea: Show enough process visibility for the task and user, but do not maximize transparency by default.

mechanics.name: Uncertainty changes behavior
mechanics.idea: Use uncertainty to trigger verify, ask, draft-only, review, or stop behaviors rather than relying on confidence meters alone.

mechanics.name: Memory lifecycle
mechanics.idea: Memories can be active, uncertain, superseded, or archived and carry temporal validity metadata.

mechanics.name: Temporal awareness
mechanics.idea: Time elapsed since a fact, tool result, or decision was observed should affect whether Wooolfmesh trusts it, rechecks it, or calls a tool again.

mechanics.name: Semantic time, not only message time
mechanics.idea: Memory should model when something was actually true and for how long, not only when the user happened to mention it.

mechanics.name: Memory outcome feedback
mechanics.idea: Later task success, failure, contradiction, and usefulness can increase or reduce trust in stored experience.

mechanics.name: Preserve raw episodes
mechanics.idea: Keep original evidence and task episodes as first-class memory. Summaries and consolidated lessons should never erase the evidence they came from.

mechanics.name: Purposeful forgetting
mechanics.idea: Temporary or volatile memories may decay, retire, or lose retrieval priority while stable facts remain durable. Forgetting can improve relevance when it is explicit and reversible.

mechanics.name: Pack context for purpose
mechanics.idea: Keep full private memory local and prepare the smallest relevant safe context packet for hosted reasoning.

mechanics.name: Compact provenance trail
mechanics.idea: Important results expose the source, memory, tool, or decision lineage that materially caused them without dumping raw traces.

mechanics.name: Recovery-first execution
mechanics.idea: Durable actions prefer preview, snapshots, reversible mutation, and visible undo or retry paths.

mechanics.name: External interface checkpointing
mechanics.idea: Unexpected consent, fees, permissions, disclosure, destructive actions, or goal changes create checkpoints for GUI agents.

experiments: dynamic checkpoint pressure versus confirm-everything and confirm-at-end
semantic-time memory retrieval versus dialogue-time retrieval
downstream outcome labels for memory quality
raw episode versus continuously rewritten summary
type-conditioned memory decay for volatile information
purpose-built context packets for hosted AI
recovery drill after an injected wrong intermediate action
